address: Schweizer Straße 1, Frankfurt on the Main, 60594, Germany
bio: Set on the banks of the River Main in Frankfurt, this restaurant tastefully blends the classic flair of the old building in which it is housed – beautiful high stuccoed ceilings, herringbone floors – with modern minimalist design. The cuisine draws on the Lohninger family's Austrian roots as well as international influences, and the menu has been divided into two sections accordingly: Die Heimat (homeland) and Die Welt (the world). The dishes stand out for the quality of their ingredients, their finesse and intense flavours; the kitchen team led by chef-patron Mario Lohninger deliberately avoids gimmickry and places the emphasis on flavour. Their Austrian classics such as Wiener schnitzel also go down a treat. The front-of-house team is friendly, attentive and pleasantly relaxed – anything...
